name: APJ BLD Open 2017

venue.name: Tiny Tails, 5th floor, Sharavanee Square
venue.address: Tiny Tails, Sharavanee Square, No. 745/AB, 24th main, 15th cross, J.P.Nagar, Phase 6, Bengaluru - 560078

information: Online registration ends on 21st November, 2017. On the spot registration is available if the total registration is less than 160 participants. Visit [registration and payment](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/APJBLDOpen2017#2861-registration-payment) tab for details. If you want to be a full-time volunteer mention it in the "Comment" section during registration. ***First time participants*** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab. ***Other participants*** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - Register for the competition (ensure your WCA id is mentioned) Step 3 - Pay using the details given in the payments tab. The winner of MBLD event will be declared the competition winner.
